fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.default: A chronological feed of everything that happens in your organization, derived from the audit log.

fields.name: none_description
fields.label: No activity (all categories) - description
fields.default: Every change made in your organization — invoices, customers, payments and settings — will show up here as it happens.

fields.name: category_title
fields.label: No activity in a category - title
fields.hint: {category} is the selected category filter, in lower case.

fields.name: category_description
fields.label: No activity in a category - description
fields.default: Nothing in this category has been recorded yet. Switch to "All activity" to see everything.

fields.name: no_match_description
fields.label: No search matches - description
fields.default: No events match your search or date range. Try widening the range or clearing the filters.

fields.name: no_match_more
fields.label: No matches among loaded events - description
fields.default: None of the {count} loaded events match. Load more to search further back, or clear the filters.
fields.hint: {count} is the number of events loaded so far.

fields.name: filter_note
fields.label: Search filter note
fields.default: Search and date filters apply to the {count} events loaded so far. Load more to include older activity.
fields.hint: {count} is the number of events loaded so far.

fields.name: end_of_log
fields.label: End of log
fields.default: You have reached the beginning of the log.
